annotations.title: Stop waiting for a store product

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Cancels a waiting release-on-product rule. The posts it held keep their planned time (one whose time has passed is missed, never posted late) and still need their approval. Needs `publish`; Agency plan.
(Wraps DELETE /api/v2/campaigns/builder/{id}/release-on-product/{releaseId}.)

brandId.description: Brand to act in. A brand-bound key acts in its own brand (another brandId is 403); an account-wide key defaults to the owner's active brand.
